name: negate_1
notes: P6b6f29d9b9 G4 (verifier v1). Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell.' Seat 0 casts Crash Through (a sorcery: 'Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Draw a card.'). Seat 1 holds Negate with exactly {1}{U}, is offered it in the response window and casts it: Crash Through is countered (CR 701.6a), so seat 0 draws nothing; both spells end in graveyards. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
